title: 2176. Count Equal and Divisible Pairs in an Array

examples.explanation: There are 4 pairs that meet all the requirements: - nums[0] == nums[6], and 0 * 6 == 0, which is divisible by 2. - nums[2] == nums[3], and 2 * 3 == 6, which is divisible by 2. - nums[2] == nums[4], and 2 * 4 == 8, which is divisible by 2. - nums[3] == nums[4], and 3 * 4 == 12, which is divisible by 2.
Since no value in nums is repeated, there are no pairs (i,j) that meet all the requirements.
